role: Abstract base for per-world data files kept by MapStorage (villages.dat, map_N.dat, structure data): a name, a dirty flag, and abstract NBT read and write.
scope_reason: It is only save-file bookkeeping: the dirty flag decides when MapStorage writes a .dat file and has no effect on game state. The native engine persists state through its own snapshots (snapshot.c); the data the subclasses hold (VillageCollection, MapGenStructureData) is indexed in their own records.

members.name: mapName
members.note: The data file name, e.g. villages.

notes: Judgement call: scoped not_needed because nothing observable in a tick depends on the dirty flag. If the native engine ever writes vanilla-format saves, MapStorage and this base become io work.
